name: iiinie-sendgrid
description: Send emails, run campaigns, manage contacts, and read stats through SendGrid — by just asking Claude.
long_description: Open-source SendGrid connector by IIInigence (https://iiinigence.com). Gives Claude 9 tools: send transactional email, create and send Single Send campaigns to your marketing lists, manage contacts and lists, look up verified senders, and read email + campaign statistics. Includes a read-only mode so you can connect safely before enabling sending. You need a SendGrid API key (Settings → API Keys → Restricted Access: Mail Send, Marketing, Template Engine read, Stats read) and a verified sender address.

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Send a transactional email to one or more recipients

tools.name: send_campaign_to_list
tools.description: Create and send a campaign to marketing lists

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: List recent campaigns and their status

tools.name: list_contact_lists
tools.description: List marketing lists with contact counts

tools.name: list_contacts_in_list
tools.description: List contacts in a list, with names and custom fields

tools.name: add_contact
tools.description: Add or update a contact, optionally assigning lists

sendgrid_api_key.title: SendGrid API Key
sendgrid_api_key.description: Create at SendGrid → Settings → API Keys. Use Restricted Access: Mail Send (Full), Marketing (Full), Template Engine (Read), Stats (Read).

from_email.title: From email (verified sender)
from_email.description: The email address you send from. Must be verified in SendGrid (Settings → Sender Authentication).

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: When on, Claude can read stats, lists, and contacts but cannot send emails or make changes. Turn off when you're ready to let Claude send.
